bio.text: Andrea Campbell became the 45th Attorney General of Massachusetts on January 18, 2023.
WBUR reported that she grew up in Roxbury and the South End neighborhoods of Boston and attended Boston Latin School, Princeton University and UCLA Law School.
She worked as deputy legal counsel to Gov. Deval Patrick and was a Boston city councilor, serving as council president.

sources.title: Andrea Campbell sworn in as the state's attorney general
